properties.site-address: Five Acres campus Berry Hill surplus land
properties.notes: land to become available following the relocation of the present further education college as part of a mixed scheme. Identified in Allocations Plan as an opportunity for mixed development. May be developed on site of former college or part thereof. Site area of total brownfield element is approximately 2.6ha though not all may be available for redevelopment- available area between 0.98 ha and 2.6ha. new build on site suitable for redevelopment of some elements on site
